in_marathi.name: Tejendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power, God of Energy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tejendra is a name of Lord Indra, the Hindu God of Rain, Storm, and Power. He is the King of the Devas and the ruler of the heavens. The name Tejendra comes from the Sanskrit words 'Tejas' meaning 'Might, Power, Energy' and 'Indra' meaning 'King, Ruler'. Tejendra represents the embodiment of power and strength.
